paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the Amazon Music FP&A team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because the role owns the long-term planning model and the OP1 and OP2 cycles, so the work shapes how the business plans, not just how it reports.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and streamlined the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%.
That maps to the planning model, guidance cycles and variance work on your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
